title: geum urbanum var. hispidum
intro: Geum urbanum var. hispidum, commonly known as Rough Avens, is a variant of the Geum urbanum plant species, native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Geum urbanum var. hispidum include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve flatulence, as well as its potential to act as an antimicrobial and antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of Geum urbanum var. hispidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
